# zhi2-web-admin Git Submodule Workflow
zhi2-web-admin is a submodule of the parent repo; independent git repo; changes must go through submodule worktrees.

## Workflow
- Develop in independent submodule worktree; after commit, fast-forward merge back to develop/v3.0.0 and push; then commit gitlink change (M zhi2-web-admin) in parent repo and push parent; delete worktree and temp branch after use.
- Exception: when user says "work on mainline branch", develop directly on mainline (e.g., develop/v2.6.2-suzhufang) without worktree (task2295 monthly report staging export).
- Parent repo `git worktree add` auto-provisions nested zhi2-web-admin submodule worktree (its .git points to .git/worktrees/.../modules/zhi2-web-admin); but the submodule working tree files are empty until `git submodule update --init` inside the new parent worktree.
- Parent `-b` only branches the parent repo; the submodule needs a separate task branch created afterward.
- Example 2026-11-09: created worktree for fix/contract-version-dialog-public-component from clean HEAD; populated submodule; branched submodule to same name.

## Verification Notes
- Worktree lacks node_modules; borrow main workspace node_modules for SFC compilation check; pure Vue2 Options API pages are compile-safe if consistent.
- Forbid PowerShell Get/Set-Content on Chinese Vue files (breaks UTF-8+BOM); use read/edit tools.
- Worktree cut from HEAD excludes main workspace uncommitted changes; build verification can be done in main workspace (vite under worktree stricter may fail).
- Yulin submodule worktree shares same vite rootDir D:/repository/榆林G; build writes same dist and overwrites; isolate with --outDir; Yulin changes land on develop/v2.6.2-yulin (submodule only, no parent branch).

## Remote Push and Cleanup
- When remote develop/v3.0.0 advanced in parallel and not fast-forwardable, forbid force push: first merge fix branch into submodule develop/v3.0.0 and push, then merge remote develop in parent to resolve gitlink conflict to new submodule head; keep both sides on same-file conflicts.
- Submodule same-file parallel conflict example: #6337 beginDialogAsyncLoad out-of-order guard vs #6235 paginateRows slice in chooseHouseDialog.vue; keep both methods and use applyOriginPage (with paginateRows slice and syncOriginSelection).
- On parallel remote advance, merge (not rebase) to preserve parent gitlink commit hash; remote CI unused-files vite.config.js fix can be merged into submodule.
- Worktree cleanup: if junction to main workspace node_modules exists, first cmd /c rmdir to remove junction then delete worktree; if worktree contains submodule, git refuses direct deletion, only delete its own dir then prune.
- If submodule .git link missing, git -C $sub silently falls back to parent; must restore .git link before push; accidentally deleted worktree can be recovered by restoring .git link and checkout with no loss.
- 2026-11-09 accidentally deleted main workspace zhi2-web-admin .git link, worktree and node_modules: rebuilt .git link with retained gitdir and reset --hard HEAD to recover tracked files, npm install to restore 870 deps, git status clean, build passed, no loss.

## Parent Repo Local Config
- Parent repo env/.env records local proxy address switch, local debug config not for commit/push.

# 新增 eslint 规则校验重复 vue options
新增 eslint 规则 duplicate-attributes/no-duplicate-vue-options，用于校验 Vue 文件中 methods 等选项是否存在重复定义。

## 背景
- 在 zhi2-web-admin 下执行 npm run lint（eslint src/**/*.{vue,js}），退出码 1，共 2493 条 error（0 warning），其中约 2486 条可用 --fix 自动修复（多为 quotes、semi、indent、comma-dangle）

## 规则命中
- 新规则共报 3 处重复定义：
  - src/views/maintenance/planBid/components/maintenanceItemDialog.vue：methods 内重复定义 getQueryParams
  - src/views/property/complexChange/detail.vue：methods 内重复定义 getForm
  - src/views/solicitation/components/maintenanceItemDialog.vue：methods 内重复定义

## 验证与归属
- 验证证据: extracted source=cursor project=bugfix
- 会话: e9b82eae-9a23-4947-a2d0-d40f550dbd2c
- 所属项目: bugfix
